places-segment-pomata-chaca-chaca-tiwana.story: From Pomata it runs 203 km to Pomata; allow about 3 h 30 of riding. On the way it passes Segment Arbolera-Parcco Chua Chua, Segment Desaguadero Titijoni, Tiwanaku: Spiritual and Political Centre o and back through Segment Desaguadero Titijoni. The highest point is about 4,100 m. It crosses from Peru into Bolivia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
